name: Swiss Confederation

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 39,510 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 9,092,436. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 21,300 active (professional cadre plus recruits in service at any time). CIA Factbook 2024: ~145,000 Swiss Armed Forces incl. ~20,000 professional cadre; the rest is the militia, counted under reserves.

trainedReserves.note: CIA Factbook 2024: ~145,000 Swiss Armed Forces strength (militia; mid). High: IISS as quoted 196,450 reserves.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 21,300 minus infantry P roles (5,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to 1939-45 Swiss mobilization (~450,000 + ~200,000 auxiliaries from ~4.2 million, ~15%) scaled down for today's 140,000-strong militia and limited equipment.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 624,000,733,724 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 9,092,436 = 68,629. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 779,513,721,079 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 624,000,733,724 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 0.76% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 0.70% in 2024, 0.67% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 25.0% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/CHE/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 2.24% (2025). s = 0.46 (net self-sufficiency 2022, https://www.srf.ch/news/schweiz/lebensmittelproduktion-so-steht-es-um-die-selbstversorgung-der-schweiz). Mid 1 - 0.0224/0.46 = 0.95. Low: a x 1.5, s 0.42 = 0.92. High: s 0.50 (gross rate is higher than net) = 0.96. Import dependence: about half of calories imported; compulsory stockpiles. Audit follow-up 2026-10-29: 0.0 -> 0.95, rule changed: value is the share of production not eaten by the farm population, import dependence goes in the note.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 4,518,296 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.131% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 46,370. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. GDELS-Mowag Kreuzlingen Piranha (exports). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Swiss_Armed_Forces)

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 4,122 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

majorPorts.note: Landlocked; Rhine port of Basel only (CIA Factbook).

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Not in the quoted UNCTAD table; CIA Factbook lists 17 Swiss-flag vessels (2023) of which 14 bulk carriers (~30-60,000 DWT each).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Short interior lines, militia logistics.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.3: Alpine terrain, fortress network, total population support and harsh mountain winter.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:CHE (Liechtenstein excluded). Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Militia army: active is professional cadre plus recruits in service; the ~145,000 militia is trainedReserves. Force counts from the Wikipedia Swiss Armed Forces equipment list and active Swiss military aircraft list; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits and air defence are educated guesses (grade D). Landlocked: ships tech 0 (lake patrol boats only).
